name: event-junkie

scripts.//configLoader: Every Vite and Vitest command loads its config with Node's own ESM loader, not the default Rolldown bundle (#382). The config chain imports with explicit `.ts`, and events-frontend/AGENTS.md § Config-loader imports says why.
scripts.//test:a11y: The axe/WCAG sweep on its own, for iterating on markup without paying for the whole e2e suite. It also runs as part of `test:e2e` — this is a filter, not a second check, so there is nothing extra to wire into CI.
scripts.//build-only: Two builds: the app, then the meta-injection sidecar into dist-injector/ (vite.injector.config.ts). One script so the two images a release ships are always built from the same tree.
scripts.build-only: vite build --configLoader native && vite build --configLoader native --config vite.injector.config.ts
scripts.//generate:api: Version pinned EXACTLY, and deliberately still `npx` rather than a devDependency. openapi-typescript@7 declares `peer typescript@^5.x` and this project is on TypeScript 6, so installing it locally fails to resolve; npx runs it in isolation with its own TypeScript, which is why it works at all. Pinning the exact version closes the reproducibility half of the problem (an unpinned range can reshape the whole generated file), and the isolation means its TypeScript never enters our tree. Revisit when openapi-typescript widens the peer range. Requires a running BFF — see README. scripts/api-schema-parity.sh reads the version from this script, so it stays the only pin.
scripts.//check:lint: What CI runs: `lint` without `--fix`, so a finding with an automatic fix fails instead of being rewritten on the runner and passing (#2037). Not `lint:ci`, which `lint:*` would match. `npm run lint` repairs what this reports.
scripts.//check:format: What CI runs: `format` without writing, so a file the pinned oxfmt would change fails the build (#2243). `npm run format` repairs what this reports. An oxfmt bump that changes the output fails it too, until the bump's PR carries the reformat.
scripts.//check:knip: Unused files, exports and dependencies. knip.jsonc names the entries no plugin finds and the exceptions, each with a reason.

//overrides: CVE-2026-45822 remediation, and the only lever that reaches it. `shadcn-vue` needs `vue-metamorph`, which needs `postcss-styl`, which pins `stylus@^0.57.0` — and stylus below 0.59.0 parses CSS through `css@3` and the deprecated `source-map-resolve`, which is what drags in `decode-uri-component`. Pinning that package directly is not an option, because its only fixed release (0.5.0) is ESM-only and `source-map-resolve` requires it from CJS. stylus 0.59.0 replaced `css` with `@adobe/css-tools`, so overriding stylus deletes the branch instead of patching its leaf. `postcss-styl` is at its latest and still pins ^0.57.0; drop this override when it widens the range. Nothing here runs the stylus parser — the project has no .styl files, and the only thing the build takes from shadcn-vue is `dist/tailwind.css`.
//version: A placeholder. No file carries the version (ADR-032), and no release changes this field. The version the site displays comes from GET /meta, never from here. See docs/LEGAL.md §4.6.
